roles.name: Main AR
roles.summary: The anchor. Controls long lanes and power positions so the rest of the team can fight on their terms.
hp: Hold the lanes and power positions that overlook the hill instead of standing on it.
Watch the enemy spawn side and call where they are coming from.
Cover teammates as they rotate, then lock a long angle on the next hill.
Stay alive. A living AR keeps your spawns stable.
snd: Anchor a site or watch the main lane. Your job is information and trades, not first contact.
Hold crossfires with a teammate and slow pushes down with utility.
Late in the round, play the bomb and the clock instead of hunting.

roles.name: Flex
roles.summary: Fills whatever the team needs: AR or SMG depending on the map, first to the next hill, and the glue between the two pairs.
hp: Leave early to scout and set up the next hill before it moves.
Swap between AR and SMG classes depending on the map and the hill.
Fill gaps: if the slayers are down, hold time; if the hill is held, help break it.
snd: Lurk or support depending on the plan and catch rotations off a flank.
Gather info for the team and stay ready to trade either pair.
Adapt your class to the map: AR for open sightlines, SMG for tight sites.

roles.name: Entry SMG
roles.summary: The spearhead. Breaks held hills and opens rounds with aggressive, fast fights.
hp: First in to break a held hill. Create space for your team to follow.
Push into the enemy setup to flip spawns when your team is ready to follow.
Take fights, but not alone. Make sure a teammate can trade you.
snd: Look for the opening pick to put your team up a player.
Hit with a trade partner directly behind you.
Use utility before you swing. Never dry peek a held angle.

roles.name: Second SMG
roles.summary: The objective player. Lives in or next to the hill, trades the entry and wins the time.
hp: Play inside or right next to the hill and hold time.
Trade the Entry SMG and clean up the fights they start.
Clear lethals and contest late when the hill is about to rotate.
snd: Trade the entry and secure the plant or defuse.
Support the site with utility and hold post-plant positions.
Call what you see. You are often the last player near the bomb.

hp: Rotate as a group. Start moving before the hill ends and send the Flex early to scout and set up.
Never trickle in one at a time. Group up and break the hill together.
While holding, keep at least one player outside the hill on an off-angle.
Stay within trading distance of a teammate on every fight.
Track score and time. Giving up the end of a hill to set up early on the next one can win more points.
Call the enemy spawn every time. It tells you which lanes they will use.
snd: Play for information first. Use utility and sound before you commit.
Trade every fight. Avoid 1v1s when a teammate can swing with you.
Never dry peek a long angle. Clear it with a smoke, flash or stun first.
On defense, set crossfires on site and let one player rotate on info.
On attack, spread out for info, then commit all four players to one site.
After the plant, play positions that watch the bomb instead of hunting.
